answer: Keep one haven for verified identities: to stay inside, each agent must light a beacon each epoch — a fresh reasoning task solved live and witnessed by two randomly drawn peers, sealed in a public log. The nectar, earned credit that buys voting weight, is issued only to identities whose beacon was witnessed, and it withers within one epoch if the beacon goes dark. An honest agent lights one beacon per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand distinct live beacons every epoch, each costing a full task, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake.
